properties.say: Thank you for calling the New Jersey Prevention Hub Warm Line. If this is an emergency, please hang up and dial 911. Warm Line hours are 9AM to 4PM. For immediate resource assistance, visit www.gethelpnj.org. To hear this message again, press 1. To leave a voicemail for a Warm Line representative, press 2.
